offering_description.value: Sells cloud-based work management software to enterprises and government agencies, delivered as subscriptions. Products cover project portfolio management, sales enablement, proposal automation, content management and records management.

primary_products.value: work management software; sales enablement software; proposal automation software; records management software; content management software

customer_segment.value: B2B: enterprises and mid-sized companies across many industries; B2G: government agencies and public-sector bodies

end_markets.value: enterprise software; financial services; healthcare; government; manufacturing

revenue_model.value: subscription: cloud software subscriptions for enterprise and government customers; service fees: implementation, consulting and training

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: takes in product development and hosting costs, sells cloud software subscriptions to enterprises and government; service provider: provides implementation and consulting, sold to software customers

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: work management, sales enablement, content and records management software sharing enterprise customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: enterprise sales teams selling to large accounts; partners / resellers: channel partners and resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: data privacy and records retention rules such as GDPR, plus government security requirements
